mapper.select: select sum(payment_amount) from payment_record where create_time between #{reportStartTime} and #{reportEndTime}

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') as chartTitle,
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as chartTitle,
SUM(payment_amount) as paymentAmount FROM payment_record WHERE create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}
AND payment_status = #{paymentStatus}
AND payment_status != 2 GROUP BY
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m')
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d')
ORDER BY chartTitle

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') as chartTitle,
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as chartTitle,
COUNT(*) as paymentCount FROM payment_record WHERE create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}
AND payment_status = #{paymentStatus}
AND payment_status != 2 GROUP BY
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m')
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d')
ORDER BY chartTitle

SELECT CASE payment_status WHEN 0 THEN '已确认' WHEN 1 THEN '待确认' WHEN 2 THEN '已作废' ELSE '未知状态' END as chartTitle, COUNT(*) as paymentCount, SUM(payment_amount) as paymentAmount FROM payment_record WHERE create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY payment_status ORDER BY payment_status
